title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
native_title: 転生したらスライムだった件
source: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime light novels by Fuse (main story finished, 23 volumes, Nov 2025). Snapshots use the end of the main story.
world: Office worker Satoru Mikami is stabbed and reborn as a slime in a fantasy world. With the skill Great Sage and the power to devour and copy, he befriends the sealed Storm Dragon Veldora, takes the name Rimuru Tempest, and builds a peaceful nation of monsters. After becoming a Demon Lord, he leads the Jura Tempest Federation through wars with human nations and other Demon Lords. Cozy nation-building mixed with huge battles.
power_system: Skills (Unique and Ultimate) grow through evolution; naming a monster gives it power. Rimuru's Predator devours and copies abilities; Great Sage became Raphael and then Ciel. Demon Lords form the Octagram.
